channel.title: Docker Hub incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Docker Hub's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Tags pushed on July 29th may not be visible in Hub [resolved]
item.description: Resolved

item.title: hub.docker.com has degraded performance [resolved]
item.description: Service are restored back to normal

item.title: Hub may experience intermittent timeouts [resolved]
item.description: The system has been restored to normal operational levels

item.title: Emails are not being delivered due to vendor outage [resolved]
item.description: Vendor issue resolved

item.title: Users may experience increased error rate for push [resolved]
item.description: Error rates are back to normal

item.title: Customers are experiencing Image push webhooks not firing as expected [resolved]
item.description: The issue is now resolved

item.title: Degraded Hub performance [resolved]
item.description: Docker Hub performances are back to normal.

item.title: Automated Builds and Bitbucket [resolved]
item.description: Issue appears to be resolved

item.title: Degraded Hub performance [resolved]
item.description: Internal maintenance has completed, system has recovered.

item.title: Authentication errors and delays when signing into Docker Desktop [resolved]
item.description: Our authentication provider has concluded the incident, citing that authentication is functioning as expected. Docker authentication remains stable.

item.title: Transient issue for accessing newly created repositories from Hub UI [resolved]
item.description: The system remains stable. We will continue monitoring and investigate the service degradation happened between 8AM and 10AM CET.

item.title: Investigating issues signing into Docker Desktop [resolved]
item.description: Authentication services remain stable. We are continuing to work directly with the affected customers on client-specific issues unrelated to Docker services.

item.title: Issue creating new organizations [resolved]
item.description: Errors affecting organization creation have been resolved and systems remain stable.

item.title: Internal auth system failures affecting logins across the platform [resolved]
item.description: The incident is resolved. Authentication is working normally.

item.title: Docker Hub degradation [resolved]
item.description: Our provider communicated that they fixed their issue. We are resolving this incident as no related issue has been identified on our side.

item.title: Increased 500 errors on Hub and Registry [resolved]
item.description: Incident resolved.

item.title: Increase in service errors for Testcontainers Cloud and Offload [resolved]
item.description: Cloudflare has recovered and so have Testcontainers Cloud and Offload.

item.title: Login failures [resolved]
item.description: This issue is resolved. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Creating new DHI mirrored repositories is currently unavailable [resolved]
item.description: We are not seeing errors creating new DHI repository mirrors. This issue has been resolved. Thanks for your patience.

item.title: Logins failing [resolved]
item.description:
After rolling out fixes earlier, we have not seen a recurrence of the login failures.
The login issues have been resolved. Thank you for your patience

item.title: Intermittent issues with hub and APIs [resolved]
item.description: This has been fully resolved.

item.title: Docker Build Cloud Degraded Performance [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. Docker Build Cloud availability is back to normal.

item.title: Docker Hub Automated builds incident [resolved]
item.description: Incident has been resolved. Users should now be able to retry their builds

item.title: Issues accessing Registry, Hub, Scout, DBC, DHI [resolved]
item.description: This incident is resolved.

item.title: Disruption of Hub Services [resolved]
item.description: All systems are working normally.
